SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS

APO 500
5 May 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Shortage of Japanese Laborers.
1. References:
a. Memorandum for Japanese Government, subject, "Shortage of Japanese Laborers," dated 19 December 1947 SCAPIN 1832.
b. Memorandum for Japanese Government, subject, "Shortage of Japanese Laborers," dated l6 January 1948 SCAPIN 1832/1.
2. The distribution of the prescribed food and clothing ration to laborers has improved during the past three months. Although it is desired that energetic supervision and control be continued in this matter, the reports of progress as directed in paragraph 3, SCAPIN I832/1, are no longer required.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
